meta.title: Privacy policy — WebFully
meta.description: How WebFully processes personal data and cookies under the GDPR.

sections.label: Privacy / GDPR
sections.title: Privacy
sections.lead: Here we describe what data we collect, why and for how long, and which rights you have.

parts.title: Data controller
paragraphs: WebFully is run by [Company name AB], reg. no. 000000-0000, Mjölby, Sweden, which is the controller for the processing of your data. Contact: info@webfully.se.

parts.title: What data we collect
paragraphs: When you send an enquiry through the form we process the details you provide.
list: Type of work, budget and your description

parts.title: Why we process the data
paragraphs: We use the data to answer your enquiry, prepare a proposal and, if we start working together, to fulfil the agreement. The legal basis is your consent and our legitimate interest in answering enquiries.

parts.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: Enquiries that do not lead to an assignment are deleted after 12 months. Data required for bookkeeping is kept as long as the law requires.

parts.title: Who can access it
paragraphs: We never sell your data. We use providers for hosting and email who process data on our behalf under data processing agreements.

parts.title: Cookies
paragraphs: Today the site only uses necessary storage in your browser: your colour mode and your cookie choice. We use no cookies for statistics or marketing. If we add them we will ask first, and you can change your choice through Cookie settings at the bottom of the page.

parts.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to know what data we hold about you, to have it corrected or erased, to restrict processing, to object, and to receive it in a machine-readable format. You can withdraw your consent at any time.

parts.title: Complaints
paragraphs: If you believe we process your data incorrectly, contact us or file a complaint with the Swedish Authority for Privacy Protection (IMY), imy.se.
